summary: BOARD-2 implemented the lazy PixiJS board route with pan, pinch and wheel zoom, 500 ms viewport persistence, resize and WebGL context-loss recovery, 200 px culling, a bounded texture cache, and complete teardown; targeted unit, Playwright, lint, typecheck, format, and build checks pass.

payload.agentOutputExcerpt: BOARD-2 implemented the lazy PixiJS board route with pan, pinch and wheel zoom, 500 ms viewport persistence, resize and WebGL context-loss recovery, 200 px culling, a bounded texture cache, and complete teardown; targeted unit, Playwright, lint, typecheck, format, and build checks pass.
decisions: CaseBoardPage lazily imports BoardCanvas; only BoardCanvas, usePixiApp, and BoardScene import pixi.js, keeping the initial shell free of PixiJS.
usePixiApp creates one Application, keeps the ticker stopped, and renders only on camera or snapshot changes through requestAnimationFrame.
Reset view applies DEFAULT_BOARD_VIEWPORT through applyTemporaryViewport and never schedules a write; a later reload restores the stored camera.
Viewport writes are debounced 500 ms and serialized through a promise chain so an older async write cannot land after a newer one.
Card containers are placeholder paper, pin, title, and type art; BOARD-3 owns photo sprites, drag, and lift.
interfaces: BoardSnapshot { caseId, caseTitle, cards: { id, title, type, position }[] }
usePixiApp({ hostRef, snapshot, viewport, canvasLabel }) -> { status, error, contextLost, viewportSize, retry, recover }
BoardScene(app, { snapshot, viewport }) with setSnapshot, setViewport, resize, rebuildAfterContextLoss, and destroy
BoardTextureCache<T extends DestroyableTexture>({ maxTextures }) with acquire, touch, setVisible, release, releaseCard, releaseOffscreen, and destroy
AppRoutes gains boardRepository and loadBoardRepository; /case/:caseId lazy-loads CaseBoardPage.
agentReportedTests: npm run test:e2e -- e2e/board.spec.ts: exit 0, 6 tests across desktop, tablet-landscape, and phone
npm test: exit 0, 505 tests across 35 files
warnings: docs/EXECUTION-AUDIT.jsonl has a pre-existing engine-generated modification that was not authored or touched.
The Open card list link points at /case/:caseId/list, whose dedicated route remains BOARD-5 work.
Card photos are intentionally placeholders in BOARD-2; texture upgrade and drag belong to BOARD-3.
validationLimitations: Culling uses the required 200 px viewport margin and the texture cache enforces 200 residents with recovery tests, but the 150-card culling assertion and FPS harness belong to BOARD-4 and QA. Tablet 45 FPS still needs human verification.
Playwright covers Chromium desktop, tablet, and phone only; Firefox and WebKit are not exercised here.
The context-loss journey tests the explicit Restore action; the automatic browser-restore branch is implemented but not separately exercised.
payload.taskDescription: Build BoardCanvas, usePixiApp, BoardScene, and textureCache. The case page loads the case and cards, mounts the canvas, renders the cork background and card containers, wires pan/pinch/wheel zoom to the board store, handles resize, WebGL context loss and restore, and destroys the app, ticker, textures, and listeners on unmount. Keep the Pixi import confined to src/board and lazy-load BoardCanvas from CaseBoardPage. Replace the case placeholder in routes and add links to capture and the card list route. Persist viewport changes with a 500ms debounce through CaseRepository; restore the stored viewport on load. Do not implement card drag, fit, minimap, or strings yet.
